mentions.name: Custody trial data management app
mentions.description: A Django app that organizes all data related to a custody trial. Emails, SMS messages, notes, official records, and voice memos can be attached to a timeline, tagged, and searched, and a command-line interface allows quickly adding notes and attaching files in addition to the UI.
mentions.source_excerpt: (3) Django app to handle all the data related to custody trial. Emails, SMS, notes, official records, voice memos, etc. can be attached to a timeline, and tagge and searchable. It has command line interface for adding data, in addition to UI, so I can quickly add notes and attach files.
